title: Completed Vendor Performance Scorecard Data Contract
description: Additive structural schema validating completed Vendor Performance Scorecard artifact data payloads (PMO-06.09).

metric_kpi.description: What is being measured, named so that both sides would recognise it. "Quality" is not a metric; "defects found in acceptance, per hundred items delivered" is, because a word cannot be measured twice and compared across periods.

target_score.description: The level agreed in advance, with the period it applies to. A target written after the result is known is not a target, it is a description, and this column is the one that makes the variance column mean anything.

actual_score.description: What was measured, and how. The measure is stated with the score so that a later reader can tell whether the same method was used in both periods; a number whose method has changed is not comparable to a number whose method did not.

variance.description: Target minus actual, with the direction that matters. Whether a positive number is good or bad depends on the metric, and stating it here is what stops the sign being argued about instead of the performance.

corrective_action.description: What happens because of the variance, and by when. Written only where there is a shortfall, and naming who does it: a scorecard that records a variance and no response produces the same variance next period, because the only thing that changed in between was the number.
